info.name: Mail7 Email Validation API
info.description:
Real-time email verification: format, MX, live SMTP and disposable detection.

**Honest classification.** `status` is `Valid`, `Not Valid`, or `Unknown`. `valid` is `null` when an address could not be verified (catch-all, greylisting, disposable) - branch on `status`, and do not treat Unknown as invalid.

Auth: the `X-API-Key` header is optional. Without it you use the free anonymous tier (rate-limited). Get a key at https://mail7.net.

Set the `baseUrl` and `apiKey` collection variables before running.

header.description: Optional. Leave empty for the free anonymous tier.

request.description: Validate one email address. Returns status (Valid/Not Valid/Unknown), valid (bool|null), formatValid, mxValid, smtpValid, mx_servers, is_disposable.

response.name: Valid
response.body:
{
  "email": "postmaster@gmail.com",
  "valid": true,
  "formatValid": true,
  "mxValid": true,
  "smtpValid": true,
  "status": "Valid",
  "error": null,
  "details": "Email validation result: Valid - Email exists",
  "mx_servers": ["gmail-smtp-in.l.google.com"],
  "smtp_message": "Email exists",
  "is_disposable": false
}

request.description: Full mail-configuration check for a domain (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, DNSSEC, BIMI).
